- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo, navigation links **HOME, FASHION, TRENDS, CONTACT**, and a search icon.
- The centered article introduces the “official SHEIN reviewer program” and product-testing opportunities.
- A prominent survey-style prompt reads **“One last question and we will show you how!”**, asking how the user prefers to receive free items, with green buttons labeled **“Store pickup”** and **“Home delivery.”**
- Below is a large **SHEIN** heading and an **“OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM”** badge.
- The article says selected users may receive products to evaluate, that selection is **“never guaranteed,”** and includes a section titled **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING.”**
- Ads are visible above and to the right, including **“Meet Slackbot.”** with a **SIGN UP** button and a Capital One Shopping ad reading **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **Apply Codes** button.
- The page uses a narrow centered content column with substantial white space, and a vertical scrollbar indicates more content below.

- A prominent prompt reads **“One last question and we will show you how!”**, asking how the user would prefer to receive free items. Two green buttons are labeled **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- Below is a large **SHEIN** logo and an **OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM** badge, followed by text explaining that selected users may receive products to evaluate, that participation is not guaranteed, and that products can include clothing, shoes, and accessories.
- A lower section begins with **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING.”**
- Ads appear above and to the right: one says **“Meet Slackbot.”** with a **SIGN UP** button; another says **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **Apply Codes** button.
- No visible text-entry fields are present. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom.
